Command used to setup a Hatchet instance

Usage:
  hatchet-admin quickstart [flags]

Flags:
      --cert-dir string               path to the directory where certificates should be stored (default "./certs")
      --generated-config-dir string   path to the directory where the generated config should be written (default "./generated")
  -h, --help                          help for quickstart
      --overwrite                     whether generated files should be overwritten, if they exist (default true)
      --skip stringArray              a list of steps to skip. possible values are "certs", "keys", or "seed"

Global Flags:
      --config string   The path the config folder.
      --version         print version and exit.
